rubric: Keep exact data, code, environment, model and evaluation identities
Reject hidden slice failures and missing evidence
Explain prompt/retrieval/tool versions and deterministic LLM evaluation limits
Bind approval to an immutable bundle and revalidate rollback
Retrieve actual MLflow records and check exported-model predictions
Qualify a non-root container with a read-only model and actual readiness
setupNote: Install the course requirements including MLflow 3.16.1. The four-stage reference runs locally without Docker or cloud credentials. Run container_check.py separately with a local Docker engine. The generated service is a teaching fixture, not a production web stack.
